_meta.purpose: Known-open E2E failures the campaign is allowed to be red on. Anything failing that is NOT listed here fails the run.
_meta.why: The 'Ingest + score' step carried continue-on-error: true with the comment 'Phase 1: known-open bugs (RFQ 500 etc.) keep it RED; don't fail the job yet'. That mask was the only thing standing between a red test and a red run, so NO test outcome could ever fail the campaign. This file removes the reason for the mask: known-open bugs are named here, and everything else is a real failure.
rules: This is a RATCHET. Adding an entry needs a ticket and a reason. Removing one is always welcome.
An entry that starts passing is reported as stale and must be deleted — a stale baseline silently re-opens the hole it documented.
Do not add a failure here to make CI green. Fix it, or file it and link the ticket.
_meta.note_on_commit_labels: The commit that introduced this file is labelled [AIQ-1804] and the consent fix beside it [AIQ-1803]. Those numbers were written before the Notion pages existed and are NOT real ids. The real ones are AIQ-1812 (R4X-B, below) and AIQ-1811 (consent withdrawal, PR #1790). Trust the PR numbers, which are unambiguous: #1792 shipped this file, #1790 the consent fix.

R4X-B.reason: INTERMITTENT, not consistently broken. Failed run 31491543985, PASSED run 31494214298 — the two runs either side of the gate landing. Kept baselined so a flake cannot turn main red at random; that is the only reason it is here. Flakiness is itself the defect to chase: an audit-row assertion that passes half the time tells you the write races, and 'sometimes logged' is not a control you can describe to a customer. Do NOT delete this entry just because the scorer reports it as now-passing; delete it when the test is reliably green.
